topic: Generating historical session data for forecast
summary_markdown:
The discussion covered two main points. First, confirmation was sought regarding whether virtual facilities contribute to the 'RIGHT NOW LIVE Active devices' count on the live traffic platform; it was confirmed that they do add to this number.
Second, a task was assigned: replicating a previous process of generating historical session data (specifically for seating locations) for a client needing a long-term forecast. This involves taking one week's worth of session data and expanding it to cover an entire year, similar to a past project done for a Brazilian airport.
decisions: The live traffic platform does include virtual facilities in the 'Active devices' count.
action_items: Someone needs to generate historical session location data (yearly forecast) using methods other than the previously shared mirroring script.
